Baby Growth Tracker

Log your baby's weight and height over time and see a growth log with typical-range guidance.

General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. This is NOT a percentile chart; your pediatrician's growth chart is the authority.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your baby's date of birth once.
  2. Log each measurement: date, weight, height.
  3. Watch the growth table fill in over time.
  4. Read the typical-range note — then confirm with your pediatrician.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is typical baby growth?

Rough medians: birth ~3.3 kg/50 cm, 6 months ~7.9 kg/67 cm, 12 months ~9.6 kg/75 cm. Every baby grows at its own pace.

Is this a percentile chart?

No — this is a simple log with rough reference bands, not a WHO percentile chart. Your pediatrician's chart is the authority.

How often should I log?

Log a measurement every few weeks; more often is unnecessary and can cause needless worry.

When should I worry?

Growth concerns are best judged by your pediatrician across proper percentile charts — ask at the next visit.
